CREATE TABLE `players` (
  `id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `image` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `bio` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `position` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `jersey_number` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `stats` longtext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL CHECK (json_valid(`stats`)),
  `approved` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(3),
  `updated_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `team_id` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `first_name` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `height` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_name` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `weight` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `email` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `slug` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `players_slug_key` (`slug`),
  KEY `players_team_id_idx` (`team_id`),
  KEY `players_approved_idx` (`approved`),
  KEY `players_slug_idx` (`slug`),
  CONSTRAINT `players_team_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`team_id`) REFERENCES `teams` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

definition.Create Table:
CREATE TABLE `teams` (
  `id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `logo` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `description` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `approved` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(3),
  `updated_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `slug` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `nickname` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `short_name` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `abbreviation` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `venue` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `city` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `founded` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `contact_email` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `primary_color` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `secondary_color` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `teams_name_key` (`name`),
  UNIQUE KEY `teams_slug_key` (`slug`),
  KEY `teams_name_idx` (`name`),
  KEY `teams_slug_idx` (`slug`),
  KEY `teams_approved_idx` (`approved`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `seasons` (
  `id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `slug` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `description` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `start_date` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `end_date` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `bracket_type` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(3),
  `updated_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `registration_opens_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `registration_closes_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `seasons_slug_key` (`slug`),
  KEY `seasons_name_idx` (`name`),
  KEY `seasons_active_idx` (`active`),
  KEY `seasons_start_date_idx` (`start_date`),
  KEY `seasons_end_date_idx` (`end_date`),
  KEY `seasons_bracket_type_idx` (`bracket_type`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `league_seasons` (
  `league_id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `season_id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(3),
  `id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `start_date` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `end_date` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `registration_opens_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `registration_closes_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` enum('DRAFT','REGISTRATION','SCHEDULED','ACTIVE','PLAYOFFS','COMPLETED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
  `competition_structure` enum('SINGLE_TABLE','CONFERENCES') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SINGLE_TABLE',
  `bracket_type` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `league_seasons_league_id_season_id_key` (`league_id`,`season_id`),
  KEY `league_seasons_season_id_idx` (`season_id`),
  KEY `league_seasons_status_idx` (`status`),
  KEY `league_seasons_start_date_idx` (`start_date`),
  KEY `league_seasons_end_date_idx` (`end_date`),
  CONSTRAINT `league_seasons_league_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`league_id`) REFERENCES `leagues` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `league_seasons_season_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`season_id`) REFERENCES `seasons` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `season_teams` (
  `id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `season_id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `team_id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(3),
  `league_id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `conference_id` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `league_season_id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `featured` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `season_teams_league_season_id_team_id_key` (`league_season_id`,`team_id`),
  KEY `season_teams_season_id_idx` (`season_id`),
  KEY `season_teams_team_id_idx` (`team_id`),
  KEY `season_teams_league_id_idx` (`league_id`),
  KEY `season_teams_conference_id_idx` (`conference_id`),
  KEY `season_teams_league_season_id_idx` (`league_season_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `season_teams_conference_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`conference_id`) REFERENCES `conferences` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `season_teams_league_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`league_id`) REFERENCES `leagues` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `season_teams_league_season_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`league_season_id`) REFERENCES `league_seasons` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `season_teams_season_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`season_id`) REFERENCES `seasons` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `season_teams_team_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`team_id`) REFERENCES `teams` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `season_registration_applications` (
  `id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `league_season_id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `team_id` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `requested_team_name` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `type` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(191) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  `applicant_name` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `applicant_email` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `notes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `admin_notes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `reviewed_by_id` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reviewed_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(3),
  `updated_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `season_team_id` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `season_registration_applications_league_season_id_status_idx` (`league_season_id`,`status`),
  KEY `season_registration_applications_team_id_idx` (`team_id`),
  KEY `season_registration_applications_applicant_email_idx` (`applicant_email`),
  KEY `season_registration_applications_season_team_id_idx` (`season_team_id`),
  KEY `season_registration_applications_reviewed_by_id_fkey` (`reviewed_by_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `season_registration_applications_league_season_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`league_season_id`) REFERENCES `league_seasons` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `season_registration_applications_reviewed_by_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`reviewed_by_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `season_registration_applications_season_team_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`season_team_id`) REFERENCES `season_teams` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `season_registration_applications_team_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`team_id`) REFERENCES `teams` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `team_ownership_claims` (
  `id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `application_id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `team_id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `token_hash` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(191) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  `expires_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `verified_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(3),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `team_ownership_claims_application_id_key` (`application_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `team_ownership_claims_token_hash_key` (`token_hash`),
  KEY `team_ownership_claims_team_id_status_idx` (`team_id`,`status`),
  KEY `team_ownership_claims_expires_at_idx` (`expires_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `team_ownership_claims_application_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`application_id`) REFERENCES `season_registration_applications` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `team_ownership_claims_team_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`team_id`) REFERENCES `teams` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `team_ownerships` (
  `id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `team_id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `email` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `role` varchar(191) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OWNER',
  `verified_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `revoked_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(3),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `team_ownerships_team_id_revoked_at_idx` (`team_id`,`revoked_at`),
  KEY `team_ownerships_email_idx` (`email`),
  KEY `team_ownerships_user_id_fkey` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `team_ownerships_team_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`team_id`) REFERENCES `teams` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `team_ownerships_user_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `season_registration_roster_changes` (
  `id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `application_id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `player_id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `action` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(191) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  `jersey_number` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `position` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `processed_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(3),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `season_registration_roster_changes_application_id_player_id_key` (`application_id`,`player_id`),
  KEY `season_registration_roster_changes_player_id_status_idx` (`player_id`,`status`),
  CONSTRAINT `season_registration_roster_changes_application_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`application_id`) REFERENCES `season_registration_applications` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `season_registration_roster_changes_player_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`player_id`) REFERENCES `players` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `season_team_players` (
  `id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `league_season_id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `season_team_id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `team_id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `player_id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `jersey_number` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `position` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `joined_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(3),
  `left_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(3),
  `updated_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(191) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `season_team_players_season_team_id_player_id_key` (`season_team_id`,`player_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `season_team_players_league_season_id_team_id_player_id_key` (`league_season_id`,`team_id`,`player_id`),
  KEY `season_team_players_league_season_id_team_id_left_at_idx` (`league_season_id`,`team_id`,`left_at`),
  KEY `season_team_players_player_id_idx` (`player_id`),
  KEY `season_team_players_team_id_fkey` (`team_id`),
  KEY `season_team_players_league_season_id_status_idx` (`league_season_id`,`status`),
  CONSTRAINT `season_team_players_league_season_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`league_season_id`) REFERENCES `league_seasons` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `season_team_players_player_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`player_id`) REFERENCES `players` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `season_team_players_season_team_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`season_team_id`) REFERENCES `season_teams` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `season_team_players_team_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`team_id`) REFERENCES `teams` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `season_player_transfers` (
  `id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `league_season_id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `player_id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `from_season_team_id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `to_season_team_id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `from_roster_id` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `to_roster_id` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(191) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  `requested_by_id` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reviewed_by_id` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reason` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `reviewed_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(3),
  `updated_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `season_player_transfers_league_season_id_status_idx` (`league_season_id`,`status`),
  KEY `season_player_transfers_player_id_league_season_id_idx` (`player_id`,`league_season_id`),
  KEY `season_player_transfers_from_season_team_id_idx` (`from_season_team_id`),
  KEY `season_player_transfers_to_season_team_id_idx` (`to_season_team_id`),
  KEY `season_player_transfers_from_roster_id_fkey` (`from_roster_id`),
  KEY `season_player_transfers_to_roster_id_fkey` (`to_roster_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `season_player_transfers_from_roster_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`from_roster_id`) REFERENCES `season_team_players` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `season_player_transfers_from_season_team_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`from_season_team_id`) REFERENCES `season_teams` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `season_player_transfers_league_season_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`league_season_id`) REFERENCES `league_seasons` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `season_player_transfers_player_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`player_id`) REFERENCES `players` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `season_player_transfers_to_roster_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`to_roster_id`) REFERENCES `season_team_players` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `season_player_transfers_to_season_team_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`to_season_team_id`) REFERENCES `season_teams` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `season_roster_history` (
  `id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `league_season_id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `player_id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `season_team_id` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `roster_id` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `action` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `from_team_id` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `to_team_id` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reason` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `changed_by_id` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(3),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `season_roster_history_league_season_id_player_id_created_at_idx` (`league_season_id`,`player_id`,`created_at`),
  KEY `season_roster_history_season_team_id_created_at_idx` (`season_team_id`,`created_at`),
  KEY `season_roster_history_player_id_fkey` (`player_id`),
  KEY `season_roster_history_roster_id_fkey` (`roster_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `season_roster_history_league_season_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`league_season_id`) REFERENCES `league_seasons` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `season_roster_history_player_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`player_id`) REFERENCES `players` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `season_roster_history_roster_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`roster_id`) REFERENCES `season_team_players` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `season_roster_history_season_team_id_fkey` FOREIGN KEY (`season_team_id`) REFERENCES `season_teams` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
